subject.title: feat(browser): My Browser node-anchored turn routing (stacks on #93411)

question: Should this side-panel/node-routing work be reworked onto the merged driver "extension" relay, accepted as a separate extension-bridge direction, or paused until the prerequisite and product/security decisions settle?
rationale: The current branch predates the merged Chrome extension relay and still changes security, config, SDK, dependency, message-delivery, and browser-control boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API shape.

options.title: Rework Onto Current Relay
options.body: Have the author rebase onto current main, drop the parallel extension-bridge/extension tree, and preserve only the side-panel/node-routing work on the canonical driver "extension" path.

options.title: Accept Separate Driver Direction
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally keep a separate extension-bridge model, but then the config, docs, SDK, migration, and security proof must explicitly support two browser-extension contracts.

options.title: Pause Or Close Direction
options.body: If the side-panel copilot or node-scoped tool policy direction is not wanted now, pause or close this PR and track any remaining side-panel UX separately.

recommendation.title: Rework Onto Current Relay
recommendation.body: Have the author rebase onto current main, drop the parallel extension-bridge/extension tree, and preserve only the side-panel/node-routing work on the canonical driver "extension" path.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee for this PR and is therefore the best available owner for the merge-risk call.
